about: Wellington North is a township in Wellington County, Ontario, covering Mount Forest, Arthur, and surrounding countryside—not a single city. Saugeen headwaters farm country, small-town Main Streets, and a rural landscape between Guelph’s north orbit and Grey County define the municipality. About 12,000 people live in Wellington North Township.
